t3: Not in the previous run of this branch
t4: In the previous run of this branch, gone in this one
t5: Tell a step which files its scanners write, and Launchway reads them when the step ends, whether it passed or failed:
t6:
steps:
  scan:
    image: alpine:3.22
    run: sh scripts/scan.sh
    reports:
      findings: reports/security/*.sarif
      sbom: reports/sbom.cdx.json
t7: Findings are read from SARIF 2.1.0 files, which Semgrep, Trivy, gitleaks, CodeQL and most other scanners write. The SBOM is read from a CycloneDX JSON file, which Launchway also keeps as an {artifact} to download.
t8: Name the files a step makes, and Launchway keeps them when the step succeeds. A later step can fetch them:
t9:
steps:
  build:
    image: golang:1.23
    run: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app
    artifacts:
      - name: binary
        paths: [dist/app]
        retain: 14d
  smoke-test:
    needs: [build]
    fetch:
      - { from: build, name: binary }
    run: ./dist/app --version
